a: Mi mitztaref siman rishon lesiman sheni letaharah mide nevela, o la?
Ad kan la ibbaya lan, ella letaharah mide nevela, aval baachila – asura.
Amar leh rav acha bar rav leravina: dilma leolam la hadar beh, verabbi zera lidvarav derava kaamar, veleh la sevira leh.
Amar rav acha bar yaakov: shema minna midderabbi shimon ben lakish, mezammenin yisrael al bene meayin, veen mezammenin goy al bene meayin.
May tama? yisrael devishchita talya milleta, kevan deikka shechita meallayyta – ishteri lehu; goyim devinchira saggi lehu uvemita talya milleta, hane – keever min hachay damu.
Amar rav pappa: hava yatevna kammeh derav acha bar yaakov, uveay deema leh, mi ikka midde dilyisrael shere ulegoyim asur? vela amari leh, deamena: ha tama kaamar.

Tanya dela kerav acha bar yaakov: harotze leechol mibbehema kodem shettetze nafshah – chotech kezayit basar mibbet hashshechita, umolcho yafe yafe, umedicho yafe yafe, umamtin lah ad shettetze nafshah, veochlo, echad goy veechad yisrael muttarin bo.

Mesayyay leh lerav idi bar avin, deamar rav idi bar avin amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan: harotze sheyyavri, chotech kezayit basar mibbet shechitatah shel behema, umolcho yafe yafe, umedicho yafe yafe, umamtin lah ad shettetze nafshah, echad goy veechad yisrael muttarin bo.
Mishna hashshochet behema chayya vaof velo yatza mehen dam – kesherim, veneechalin beyadayim mesoavot, lefi shello hucheshru baddam. rabbi shimon omer: hucheshru bashshechita.
Gemara tama delo yatza mehen dam, ha yatza mehen dam – en neechalim beyadayim mesoavot. ammay? yadayim sheniyyot hen, veen sheni ose shelishi bechullin!
Umimmay divchullin askinan? dekatane chayya, deillu kadashim – chayya bekadashim mi ikka? vetu, i bekadashim, ki lo yatza mehen dam – keshera? hu atzmo laddam hu tzarich!

Vetu, i bekadashim, ki yatza mehen dam mi machshir? vehaamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin ledam kadashim sheeno machshir? shenneemar: "al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim", dam shennishpach kammayim machshir, sheeno nishpach kammayim eno machshir!
Vetu, i bekadashim, ki lo yatza mehem dam la mittachsheri, (littachsheri) [littachsheru] bechibbat hakkodesh! dekayyma lan chibbat hakkodesh machshartan.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: hacha bechullin shellekachan bechesef maaser askinan, udela kerabbi meir, ditnan:
b: Kol hattaun biat mayim middivre sofrim metamme et hakkodesh, ufosel et hatteruma, umuttar bachullin uvammaaser, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim osrim bammaaser.
Matkef la rav shimi bar ashe: mimmay? dilma ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi meir, ella baachilat maaser, aval bingia demaaser vaachila dechullin – la peligi.
Veha negia hi, middekatane neechalin beyadayim mesoavot, mi la askinan deka safe leh chavreh?

Ella amar rav pappa: hacha beyadayim techillot askinan, verabbi shimon ben elazar hi, detanya: en yadayim techillot lachullin, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir: yadayim techillot lachullin, usheniyyot latteruma.
Techillot lechullin – in, litruma – la? hachi kaamar: techillot – af lechullin, sheniyyot – litruma in, lechullin – la.
Umi ikka yadayim techillot? in, detanya: hichnis yadav levayit hamenugga – yadav techillot, divre rabbi akiva, vachachamim omrim: yadav sheniyyot.
Dechulle alma bia bemiktzat lo shemah bia, vehacha bigzera yadav attu gufo ka mippalgi.
Mar savar: yadav – kegufo shavvinhu rabbanan, umar savar: yadayim – keyadayim dealma shavvinhu rabbanan.
Velokma kerabbi akiva, deamar: yadav techillot havyayn? dilma ki kaamar rabbi akiva hane mille bitruma vekadashim, dachamiri, aval lechullin – sheniyyot havyayn.
Velihevyayn name sheniyyot, deha shaminan leh lerabbi akiva deamar: sheni ose shelishi bechullin.
Ditnan, bo beyom darash rabbi akiva: "vechol keli cheres vegomer yitma", "tame" lo neemar, ella "yitma" – letamme acherim, limmed al kikkar sheni shehu ose shelishi bechullin.
Dilma hane mille betumea deorayyta, aval bidrabbanan la.

Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya: hacha bechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh askinan, udela kerabbi yehoshua, detanya: rabbi eliezer omer: haochel ochel rishon – rishon, sheni – sheni, shelishi – shelishi.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: haochel ochel rishon vesheni – sheni, shelishi – sheni lakkodesh, veen sheni latteruma.
Bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma.
Al tohorat teruma – in, al tohorat hakkodesh – la, kasavar: chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh let behu shelishi.
Velokma

a: Bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma, verabbi yehoshua? la salka datach, dekatane "basar", dei bitruma – basar mi ikka?
Ella may, bekadashim? chayya bekadashim mi ikka? basar bevasar michallaf, basar befere la michallaf.
Amar ulla: chavrayya amrin bechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh, udela kerabbi yehoshua.
Vaana amena rabbi yehoshua hi, vela mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya chullin shennaasu al tohorat kodesh dachamiri deit behu shelishi, ella afillu chullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma name it behu shelishi.
Man chavrayya? rabba bar bar chana hi, deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: may ahdaru rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua lahadade?

Amar lo rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua: matzinu ochel chamur min haochel, deillu nivlat of tahor bachutz – lo metamme, veillu ochlah metamme begadim abbet habbelia, veanu heach lo naase ochel kammaachol?

Verabbi yehoshua: minnivlat of tahor la gamrinan, dechiddush hu. ella matzinu shehammaachol chamur min haochel, deillu maachol bichvetza, veochel ad deachel kachatzi feras, veanu heach naase ochel kammaachol?
Verabbi eliezer: tumea mishshiurin la gamrinan, veod – lidvarecha sheatta omer al rishon sheni – yafe atta omer, sheni sheni lema?
Amar lo: matzinu shehashsheni ose sheni al yede mashkin.
Amar lo: veha mashkin name techilla havu, ditnan: kol happosel bitruma metamme mashkin lihyot techilla, chutz mittevul yom.
Veod, shelishi sheni lama?
Amar lo: af ani lo amarti ella bitruma, shettohoratah
b: Tumea hi etzel hekdesh.
Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi yannay: haochel shelishi shel chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh – naasa gufo sheni lakkodesh.
Etiveh rabbi zera lerabbi assi: shelishi sheni lakkodesh, veen sheni latteruma, bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma. al tohorat teruma – in, al tohorat hakkodesh – la!
Amar leh: la mibbaya kaamar.
Veha "af ani lo amarti ella bitruma" kaamar, amorae ninhu, veallibba derabbi yochanan.
Amar ulla: haochel shelishi shel chullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma – nifsal gufo milleechol bitruma.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: shelishi sheni lakkodesh, veen sheni latteruma, bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma. sheni hu dela have, ha shelishi have.
I mehahi, hava amena: la sheni have vela shelishi have, veayyeyde deamar "sheni bakkodesh" – amar name "en sheni bitruma", ka mashma lan.
Etiveh rav hamenuna leulla: harishon shebbachullin tame umetamme, vehashsheni posel veeno metamme, vehashshelishi neechol binzid haddema.
Vei amrat nifsal gufo milleechol bitruma, safenan leh midde defasel leh legufeh? amar leh: hannach linzid haddema,

a: Delekka kezayit bichde achilat peras.
Amar rabbi yonatan amar rabbi: haochel shelishi shel teruma atzmah – asur leechol, umuttar ligga.

Veitzterich deulla, veitzterich derabbi yonatan, dei middeulla hava amena: hane mille bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma, aval teruma – bingia name asur, itzterich derabbi yonatan. vei midderabbi yonatan hava amena: hane mille teruma, aval chullin – baachila name shere, tzerichi.

Yatev rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta kammeh derav nachman, veyatev vekaamar: haochel shelishi shel chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh – tahor leechol bakkodesh, sheen lecha davar sheose revii bakkodesh ella kodesh mikkodesh bilvad.
Metiv rame bar chama: shelishi – sheni lakkodesh, veen sheni latteruma. bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma. ammay? ha lav kodesh mikkodesh hu!
Amar leh: hannach litruma, shettohoratah tumea hi etzel hakkodesh.
Umena temra? ditnan: bigde am haaretz midras lifrushin, bigde ferushin midras leochle teruma, bigde ochle teruma midras lakkodesh.
Amar rava: midrasot kaamrat? shane midrasot,
b: Shemma teshev alehen ishto nidda, aval befere la amrinan. verabbi yitzchak befere name amar.

Metiv rabbi yirmeya middifti: umi amrinan befere? vehatnan: im amar "hifrashti letochah reviit kodesh" – neeman, vela ka (metamme) [metammeya] leh teruma lekodesh. vei amrat: tohoratah tumea hi etzel hakkodesh – tetamme teruma lekodesh!
Amar leh: tumea bechibburin kaamrat? tumea bechibburin shane, demiggo dimheman akkodesh – meheman name atteruma.
Metiv rav huna bar natan: hashsheni shebbachullin metamme mashke chullin, ufosel ochle teruma, vehashshelishi metamme mashke kodesh, ufosel ochle kodesh, bechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh.
Tannae hi, detanya: chullin shennaasu al tohorat kodesh – hare hen kechullin.
Rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer: hare hen kitruma, letamme shenayim, velifsol echad.
Rabbi shimon omer: hucheshru bishchita. amar rav assi: omer haya rabbi shimon, shechitato machsheret velo dam.
Lema mesayyay leh, rabbi shimon omer: hucheshru bishchita. may lav bishchita vela bedam? la, af bishchita.
Ta shema: amar lahen rabbi shimon: vechi haddam machshir? vahalo shechita machsheret! hachi kaamar lahen: vechi dam bilvad machshir? af shechita name machsheret.
Ta shema: rabbi shimon omer: dam hammet eno machshir. may lav, ha dam shechita machshir? la, ha dam chalalim machshir, aval dam shechita may – la machshir?
Layshmeinan dam shechita, vechol shekken dam hammet! dam hammet itztericha leh, salka datach amena: ma li katleh ihu, ma li katleh malach hammavet? ka mashma lan.
Ta shema: rabbi shimon omer: dam maggefato eno machshir. may lav, ha dam shechita machshir? la, ha dam chalalim machshir. aval dam shechita may, la machshir?
Lashmeinan dam shechita, vechol shekken dam maggefato! dam maggefato itztericha leh, salka datach amena: ma li katleh kulle, ma li katleh palga.
Umay shena dam chalalim demachshayr? dichtiv: "vedam chalalim yishte".
Dam shechita name ketiv: "al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim"! hahu lemishre daman difsule hammukedashin bahanaa hu daata.

a: Salka datach amena: hoil vaasiri begizza vaavoda, daman live kevura, kamashma lan.
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: "vedam chalalim yishte" – perat ledam killuach, sheeno machshir et hazzeraim.
Tanu rabbanan: hashshochet vehittiz dam al haddallaat – rabbi omer: hucheshar, rabbi chiyyay omer: tolin.
Amar rabbi oshaya: meachar sherabbi omer hucheshar, verabbi chiyyay omer tolin, anu al mi nismoch? bou venismoch al divre rabbi shimon, shehaya rabbi shimon omer: shechita machsheret velo dam.

Amar rav pappa: hakkol modim hecha deiteh ledam mittechilla vead sof – kulle alma la peligi demachshayr. ki peligi benitkanneach haddam ben siman lesiman, rabbi savar: yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof, vehay dam shechita hu.
Rabbi chiyyay savar: enah lishchita ella bassof, vehay dam makka hu, umay "tolin"? tolin haddavar ad gemar shechita – i iteh ledam besof shechita machshir, vei la – lo machshir.
Umay "bou venismoch al divre rabbi shimon"? lerabbi shimon lo machshir, lerabbi chiyyay machshir!
Benitkanneach mihu ashvo lahadade, mar la machshir, umar la machshir, hava leh rabbi chad, veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim.
Rav ashe amar: "tolin" leolam mashma, venitkanneach lerabbi chiyyay sappoke mesappeka leh, i yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof, o enah lishchita ella bassof, umay "tolin"? lo ochlin velo sorfin.
Umay "bou venismoch al divre rabbi shimon"? lerabbi shimon lo machshir, lerabbi chiyyay sefeka, leinyan serefa mihu shavu lahadade: (umar) [ulemar] la sarfinan, (umar) [ulemar] la sarfinan.
Have leh rabbi chad, veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim, vehachi kaamar: kegon zot tolin – lo ochlin velo sorfin.

Bae rabbi shimon ben lakish: tzarid shel menachot, monin bo rishon vesheni, o en monin bo rishon vesheni? ki mahneya chibbat hakkodesh leippesole gufeh, lemimne beh rishon vesheni – la, o dilma la shena?
Amar rabbi elazar: ta shema, "mikkol haochel asher yeachel vegomer" – ochel habba bemayim – hucheshar, ochel sheeno ba bemayim – lo hucheshar.
Attu rabbi shimon ben lakish let leh ochel habba bemayim? rabbi shimon ben lakish hachi kamibbaya leh: chibbat hakkodesh keochel habba bemayim dame, o la?
Rabbi elazar name miyyitture kerae kaamar, mikkede ketiv "vechi yuttan mayim al zera", "mikkol haochel asher yeachel" lema li?
b: Lav lemaote chibbat hakkodesh? la: chad betumeat met vechad betumeat sheretz.
Utzerichi, dei ashmeinan tumeat met – hatam hu devae hechsher, mishshum dela metamme bechaadasha, aval sheretz dimtamme bechaadasha – ema la live hechsher.
Vei ashmeinan sheretz, mishshum dela metamme tumeat shiva, aval met dimtamme tumeat shiva – ema la live hechsher, tzericha.
Metiv rav yosef: rabbi shimon omer hucheshru bishchita. hucheshru – vaafillu lemimne behu rishon vesheni.
Ammay? veha lav ochel habba bemayim hu! amar leh abbaye: asauhu kehechsher mayim midderabbanan.

Amar rabbi zera: ta shema, habbotzer legat – shammay omer: hucheshar, hillel omer: lo hucheshar, ushetek leh hillel leshammay. ammay? veha lav ochel habba bemayim hu! amar leh abbaye: asauhu kehechsher mayim midderabbanan.

Amar leh rav yosef: amena lach ana hucheshru bishchita, veat amrat li asauhu kehechsher mayim, veamar lach rabbi zera, vaamart leh asauhu kehechsher mayim, lerabbi shimon ben lakish name asauhu kehechsher mayim!
Amar leh: attu rabbi shimon ben lakish litlot kamibbaya leh? ki ka mibbaya leh lisrof.
Mikkelal dechibbat hakkodesh deorayyta, mena lan? illema middichtiv "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame", hay basar deittachshar, bemay?

Illema deittachshar bedam, vehaamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin ledam kadashim sheeno machshir, shenneemar: "lo tochlennu al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim" – dam hannishpach kammayim machshir, sheeno nishpach kammayim eno machshir!

Ella deittachshar bemashke bet matbechayya, veha amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: mashke bet matbechayya lo dayyayn shehen dechan, ella sheen machshirin, vechi tema targema addam, veha "mashke" kaamar! ella lav deittachshar bechibbat hakkodesh?
Vedilma kidrav yehuda amar shemuel, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kegon shehayta lo para shel zivche shelamim, veheevirah bannachal, shechatah vaadayin mashke tofeach aleha.
Ella missefa: "vehabbasar", lerabbot etzim ulevona. etzim ulevona bene achila ninhu? ella chibbat hakkodesh machshera lehu, umeshavveya lehu ochel. hacha name, chibbat hakkodesh machshartan.

a: May? ki mahneya chibbat hakkodesh lifsula degufeh, aval lemimne beh rishon vesheni la, o dilma la shena? teku.

Mishna hashshochet et hamesukkenet, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ad shettefarkes bayyad uvaregel. rabbi eliezer omer: dayyah im zinneka. amar rabbi shimon: hashshochet ballayla, ulemachar hishkim umatza ketalim meleim dam – keshera, shezzinneka, uchemiddat rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: ad shettefarkes o vayyad o varegel, o ad shettechashkesh biznavah.

Echad behema dakka veechad behema gassa, behema dakka sheppashta yadah velo hechzira – pesula, sheenah ella hotzaat nefesh bilvad. bamme devarim amurim? shehayta bechezkat mesukkenet, aval im hayta bechezkat beria, afillu en bah echad mikkol hassimanim hallalu – keshera.
Gemara mesukkenet mimmay desharya? umimmay tissak addatin daasira? dichtiv: "zot hachayya asher tochlu", chayya echol, vesheenah chayya lo tochal. veha mesukkenet enah chayya?
Middeamar rachamana nevela lo tochel, mikkelal dimsukkenet sharya, dei salka datach mesukkenet asira – hasheta mechayyim asira, leachar mita mibbee?

Vedilma hayeynu nevela hayeynu mesukkenet? la salka datach, dichtiv: "vechi yamut min habbehema asher hi lachem leochla hannogea benivlatah", leachar mita hu dekaryay rachamana nevela, mechayyim la ikkeray nevela.
Vedilma leolam ema lach: hayeynu nevela hayeynu mesukkenet, mechayyim – baase, leachar mita – belav.
Ella, middeamar rachamana terefa lo tochal – mikkelal dimsukkenet sharya, dei salka datach mesukkenet asira, hasheta mesukkenet dela mechassera asira, terefa mibbaya?
Vedilma hayeynu terefa hayeynu mesukkenet, velaavor alav baase velo taase! im ken, nevela dichtav rachamana lema li? uma mechayyim kae ala belav vaase, leachar mita mibbaya?
Vedilma hayeynu nevela, hayeynu terefa, hayeynu mesukkenet, velaavor alav bishne lavin vaase!

Ella mehacha, "vechelev nevela vechelev terefa yease lechol melacha veachol lo tochluhu", veamar mar: lemay hilcheta amra hattora? yavo issur nevela veyachul al issur chelev, yavo issur terefa veyachul al issur chelev.
b: Vei salka datach terefa hayeynu mesukkenet, lichtov rachamana "chelev nevela yease lechol melacha vechelev terefa lo tochluhu", vaana amena: uma mechayyim ate issur terefa chayel aissur chelev, leachar mita mibbaya?!
Ella, middichtav rachamana "nevela", mikkelal ditrefa lav hayeynu mesukkenet.

Matkef la mar bar rav ashe: vedilma leolam ema lach hayeynu terefa hayeynu mesukkenet, udekaamrat: "nevela" dichtav rachamana lema li? lehach nevela dela atya mikkoach mesukkenet. vehechi dame? sheasaah gistera. hatam name, i efshar dela havay mesukkenet pureta mikkamme delifsok lerubba.
Veibbaet ema, im ken lema "chelev nevela uterefa", "chelev" "chelev" lema li? zo hi sheen chelbah chaluk mibbesarah, veyesh lecha acheret shechelbah chaluk mibbesarah, veezo zo? mesukkenet.
Veibbaet ema mehacha, "vaomar ahah Adonai elohim hinne nafshi lo metummaa unevela uterefa lo achalti minneuray vead atta velo va befi besar piggul".

"Hinne nafshi lo metummaa" – shello hirharti bayyom lavo lide tumea ballayla, "unevela uterefa lo achalti minneuray" – shello achalti besar kos kos meolam, "velo va befi besar piggul" – shello achalti mibbehema shehora bah chacham. mishshum rabbi natan amru: shello achalti mibbehema shello huremu mattenoteha.
I amrat bishlama sharya – hayeynu revuteh dichezkel, ella i amrat asira – may revuteh dichezkel?

Hechi dame mesukkenet? amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol shemmaamidin otah veenah omedet. rav chanina bar shelemya mishshemeh derav amar: afillu ochelet bekaiyyot. rame bar yechezkel amar: afillu ochelet korot.

Besura matne hachi. befumebdita matne hachi: hechi damya mesukkenet? amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol shemmaamidin otah veenah omedet, vaafillu ochelet bekaiyyot. rame bar yechezkel amar: afillu ochelet korot.
Ashkechinhu shemuel letalmidi derav, amar lehu: may amar rav bimsukkenet? amaru leh: hachi amar rav:

a: Goa vehetila rei vechishkesha beoznah – hare ze pirkus. amar lehu: itztericha leh leabba leozoze unne, sheani omer kol sheenah [osa] devarim shehammeta osa.
May ninhu devarim shehammeta osa? amar rav anan: ledidi mipparsha li minneh demar shemuel – hayta yadah kefufa ufeshatatta – davar shehammeta ose, peshuta uchefafatta – devarim sheen hammeta osa.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: behema dakka sheppashta yadah velo hechzira – pesula, sheenah ella hotzaat nefesh; ha hechzira – keshera.
I mimmatnitin, hava amena: davka dechayyfa ufashta vahadar kayyfa la, aval peshuta uchefafatta – la, ka mashma lan.

Metivi: rabbi yose omer, haya rabbi meir omer: goa bishat shechita – en ze pirkus. rabbi elazar berabbi yose omer mishshemo: afillu hetila rei vechishkesha biznavah – en ze pirkus. kashya goa aggoa, kashya rei arei!
Goa aggoa la kashya: ha deave kala, ha deame kala. rei arei name la kashya: kan beshotetet, kan bematrezet.
Amar rav chisda: pirkus sheamru – besof shechita. may besof shechita? beemtza shechita, leappoke techillat shechita dela.
Amar rav chisda: mena amena la? ditnan: behema dakka sheppashta yadah velo hechzira – pesula. emat? illema besof shechita, kol hachi teche vetezil? ella lav beemtza shechita?
Amar leh rava: leolam besof shechita, sheani omer: kol sheenah ose ken besof shechita – beyadua shennishmatah netula hemenna kodem lachen.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: pirkus sheamru – bitchillat shechita.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: mena amena la? ditnan, amar rabbi shimon: hashshochet ballayla, ulemachar matza ketalim meleim dam – keshera, shezzinneka, uchemiddat rabbi eliezer. veamar shemuel: kotle bet shechita shaninu. i amrat bishlama bitchillat shechita – shappir, ella i amrat besof shechita, lechush dilma bitchillat shechita zinneka.
Vedilma shane zinnuk, daadif.
Umi adif? vehatnan, rabbi eliezer omer: dayyay im zinneka, kal midderabban gamliel, vaadif midderabbanan.
Amar ravina: amar li samma bar chilkay, akshi ba avu devar abbuveram, veamri la achu devar abbuveram: umidderabbanan mi adif? veha tenan: vachachamim omrim: ad shettefarkes o vayyad o varegel.
Rabbanan ahe kayymi? illema adderabban gamliel – "kevan sheppirkesa" mibbee leh!
Ella peshita adderabbi eliezer, vei adif, may "ad"?
Rava amar: pirkus sheamru – besof shechita. amar rava: mena amena la? detanya: "shor
b: O chesev" – perat lechilayim, "o ez" – perat lenidme, "ki yivvaled" – perat leyotze dofen, "shivat yamim" – perat limchussar zeman, "tachat immo" – perat layyatom.
Hay yatom hechi dame? illema dilidteh immeh vahadar mita, leolam teche vetezil? ella demita vahadar yelidteh, mikki yivvaled" nafka.

Ella peshita, ze perash lemita veze perash lechayyim. i amrat bishlama baenan chiyyuta besof leda – hayeynu deitzterich kera lemaote, ella i amrat la baenan chiyyuta besof leda, lema leh? mikki yivvaled" nafka!
Amar rava: hilcheta ki ha matnita – behema dakka sheppashta yadah velo hechzira, pesula.

Bamme devarim amurim? bayyad, aval baregel, ben pashta velo kaffa, ben kaffa velo pashta – keshera. bamme devarim amurim? bedakka, aval begassa, ben bayyad ben baregel, ben pashta velo kaffa, ben kaffa velo pashta – keshera. veof, afillu lo rifref ella gappo, velo kishkesh ella zenavo – hare ze pirkus.
May ka mashma lan? kullehu tenanhi! behema dakka sheppashta yadah velo hechzira – pesula, sheenah ella hotzaat nefesh. yad – in, regel – la; dakka – in, gassa – la. of itztericha leh, dela tenan.

Mishna hashshochet lenochri – shechitato keshera, verabbi eliezer posel. amar rabbi eliezer: afillu shechatah leechol lenochri mechatzar kaved shellah – pesula, shessetam machshevet nochri laavoda zara.

Amar rabbi yose: kal vachomer haddevarim, uma bimkom shehammachshava poselet bemukedashin – en hakkol holech ella achar haoved, mekom sheen machshava poselet bechullin – eno din shello yehe hakkol holech ella achar hashshochet?
Gemara hane tannae it lehu derabbi eliezer berabbi yose, detanya: amar rabbi eliezer berabbi yose: shamati shehabbealim mefaggelin.

Mihu tanna kamma savar: i shamineh dechashshev – in, i la – la, setam machshevet nochri laavoda zara la amrinan. rabbi eliezer savar: af al gav dela shamineh dechashshev, setam machshevet nochri laavoda zara amrinan. vaata rabbi yose lememar: af al gav deshamineh dechashshev, ze mechashshev veze oved la amrinan.
Ikka deamri: bidshamineh dechashshev peligi, tanna kamma savar: ki amrinan "ze mechashshev veze oved" – hane mille bifnim, aval bechutz lo, chutz mippenim

a: La yalfinan. vaata rabbi eliezer lememar: yalfinan chutz mippenim, vaata rabbi yose lememar: afillu bifnim name "ze mechashshev veze oved" la amrinan.
Ittemar: hashshochet et habbehema lizrok damah laavoda zara, ulehaktir chelbah laavoda zara – rabbi yochanan amar: pesula, rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: mutteret.
Rabbi yochanan amar pesula: mechashshevin meavoda laavoda, veyalfinan chutz mippenim.
Resh lakish amar mutteret: en mechashshevin meavoda laavoda, vela gamrinan chutz mippenim.
Veazdu letamayyhu, deittemar: shechatah lishmah lizrok damah shello lishmah – rabbi yochanan amar: pesula, rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: keshera.
Rabbi yochanan amar pesula: mechashshevin meavoda laavoda, vegamrinan mimmachshevet piggul. rabbi shimon ben lakish amar keshera: en mechashshevin meavoda laavoda, vela gamrinan mimmachshevet piggul.
Utzericha, dei ittemar beha, beha kaamar rabbi shimon ben lakish, mishshum dechutz mippenim la yalfinan, aval penim mippenim – ema mode leh lerabbi yochanan.
Vei ittemar behach, behahi kaamar rabbi yochanan, aval beha – ema mode leh lerabbi shimon ben lakish, tzericha.

Metiv rav sheshet: amar rabbi yose: kal vachomer haddevarim, uma bimkom shemmachshava poselet bemukedashin – en hakkol holech ella achar haoved, mekom sheen machshava poselet bechullin – eno din shello yehe hakkol holech ella achar hashshochet?
May "en machshava poselet bechullin"? illema dela pasla kelal, ella zevicha daavoda zara demittasra, hechi mashkachat la?

Ella peshita meavoda laavoda, vehachi kaamar: uma bimkom shemmachshava poselet bemukedashin meavoda laavoda – en hakkol holech ella achar haoved, mekom sheen machshava poselet bechullin meavoda laavoda, ella beotah avoda – eno din shello yehe hakkol holech ella achar hashshochet?
Penim kashya lerabbi shimon ben lakish, chutz kashya lerabbi yochanan!
Bishlama penim, lerabbi shimon ben lakish la kashya: ha mikkamme deshama merabbi yochanan, ha levatar deshama merabbi yochanan. ella chutz, kashya lerabbi yochanan!
Hu motev la vehu mefarek la, bearba avodot, vehachi kaamar: uma bimkom shemmachshava poselet bemukedashin bearba avodot – en hakkol holech ella achar haoved,
b: Mekom sheen machshava poselet bechullin ella bishte avodot – eno din shello yehe hakkol holech ella achar hashshochet.

Tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan: hashshochet et habbehema lizrok damah laavoda zara ulehaktir chelbah laavoda zara – hare ellu zivche metim. shechatah veachar kach chishshev aleha – ze haya maase bekesari, velo amru bah lo issur velo hetter.
Amar rav chisda: lo amru bah issur – mishshum kevodan derabbanan. lo hetter – mishshum kevodo derabbi eliezer.
Mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam, ella dela shemane dechashshev, aval hacha dishmane dechashshev – hochiach sofo al techillato!
I name, ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam ella gabbe nochri, distam machshevet nochri laavoda zara, aval yisrael – hochiach sofo al techillato la amrinan.
Ella amar rav shezvi: lo amru bah hetter mishshum kevodo derabban shimon ben gamliel, he rabban shimon ben gamliel?
Illema rabban shimon ben gamliel degittin, ditnan: habbari sheamar "kitvu get leishti" – ratza lesachek bah.
Umaase bevari sheamar "kitvu get leishti", veala laggag venafal vamet. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: im meatzmo nafal, hare ze get, veim haruach dachattu, eno get.
Vehavenan ba: maase listor?

Chassore michassera vehachi katane: im hochiach sofo al techillato – hare ze get, umaase name bevari sheamar "kitvu get leishti", veala laggag venafal vamet. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: im meatzmo nafal – hare ze get, veim haruach dachattu – eno get.
Vedilma shane hatam, dekaamar "kitvu".

Ella amar ravina: mishshum kevodo derabban shimon ben gamliel dehacha, detanya: hakkotev nechasav laacherim, vehayu bahen avadim, veamar halla "i efshi bahen", im haya rabbo sheni kohen – hare ellu ochlin bitruma. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kevan sheamar halla "i efshi bahen" – kevar zachu bahen yorshin.
Vehavenan ba: letanna kamma, afillu omed vetzoveach?
Amar rabba, veittema rabbi yochanan: betzoveach meikkara – dechulle alma la peligi dela kana, beshotek uvassof tzoveach – dechulle alma la peligi dikna.
Ki peligi – shezzikka lo al yede acher, veshatak ulevassof tzavavch; tanna kamma savar: middishtek – kenanhu, vehay deka tzavavch – mihdar ka hadar beh.
Verabban shimon ben gamliel savar: hochiach sofo al techillato, veha dela tzevavch meikkara, savar: ki la ate lidi ammay etzvavch.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose.

Hanhu tayyaye daato letzikonya, yehuv dichre letabbache yisrael, amaru lehu: dema vetarba ledidan, mashka uvisra ledidchu. shalcha rav tovi bar rav matna lekammeh derav yosef: ki hay gavvna may? shelach leh: hachi amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe: lerabbi eliezer, yehev leh zuza letabbach yisrael, may? amar leh: chazenan, i inish allama hu dela matze medache leh – asur, vei la – amar leh: "reshaycha vehar".
Mishna hashshochet leshem harim, leshem gevaot, leshem yammim, leshem neharot, leshem midbarot – shechitato pesula.

a: Shenayim ochazin besakkin veshochatin, echad leshem echad mikkol ellu veechad leshem davar kasher – shechitato pesula.

Gemara pesula – in, zivche metim – la. ureminhi: hashshochet leshum harim, leshum gevaot, leshum neharot, leshum midbarot, leshum chamma ulevana, leshum kochavim umazzalot, leshum michael hassar haggadol, leshum shilshul katan – hare ellu zivche metim.
Amar abbaye: la kashya, ha deamar lehar, ha deamar legadda dehar. dayka name, dekatane dumeya demichael sar haggadol, shema minna.

Amar rav huna: hayta behemat chavero revutza lifne avoda zara, kevan sheshshachat bah siman echad – asarah. savar la ki ha deamar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: af al pi sheamru hammishtachave levehemat chavero lo asarah, asa bah maase – asarah.
Etiveh rav nachman lerav huna: hashshochet chattat beshabbat bachutz laavoda zara – chayyayv shalosh chattaot, vei amrat: kevan sheshshachat bah siman echad asarah – ashshechute chutz la lichayyayv,
b: Mechattech beafar hu! amar rav pappa: hacha bechattat haof askinan, dechullehu bahade hadade kaate.
Mikkede rav huna keman amra lishmateh? keulla, veulla maase kol dehu kaamar.
Ella, beomer bigmar zevicha hu ovdah.
I hachi, may irya chattat? layshmeinan zevach!
Ella amar mar zutera mishshemeh derav pappa: hacha bemay askinan? kegon shehaya chatzi kane pagum, vehosif alav kol shehu ugemaro, dechullehu bahade hadade kaatyayn.
Amar rav pappa: i lav deamar rav huna siman echad, la havya chattat teyuveteh. may maase? maase rabba.
Veamar rav pappa: i lav deamar rav huna behemat chavero, la havya chattat teyuveteh. may tama? dideh matze asar, dechavreh la matze asar.
Peshita! mahu detema: kevan dekane leh lechappara – kedideh damya, ka mashma lan.
(Naatz – siman.) rav nachman, verav amram, verav yitzchak amri: en adam oser davar sheen shello.
Metivi: hashshochet chattat bashshabbat bachutz laavoda zara – chayyayv shalosh chattaot, veokimna bechattat haof uvachatzi kane pagum. tama dechattat haof hu, dechullehu bahade hadade kaatyayn,

a: Aval zevach la. vei en adam oser davar sheeno shello, may irya chattat haof? afillu chattat behema name, kevan dekanya leh lechappara kedideh damya.
Ta shema: shenayim ochazin besakkin veshochatin, echad leshum echad mikkol ellu, veechad leshum davar kasher – shechitato pesula. hacha bemay askinan? deit leh shuttafut begavva.
Ta shema: hametamme, vehamedammea, vehamenassech – beshogeg patur, bemezid chayyayv. hacha name deit leh shuttafut begavva.

Ketannae: goy shennissech yeno shel yisrael shello bifne avoda zara – asaro, rabbi yehuda ben betera verabbi yehuda ben bava mattirin oto mippene shene devarim: echad – sheen menassechin yayin ella bifne avoda zara, veechad – sheyyachol lomar lo "lo kol hemennach shetteesor yeni leonsi".
Verav nachman verav amram verav yitzchak amri: afillu leman deamar adam oser davar sheeno shello – hane mille goy, aval yisrael letzaoreh ka mikkavven.
Ta shema: shenayim ochazin besakkin veshochatin, echad leshum echad mikkol ellu veechad leshum davar kasher – shechitato pesula. hacha bemay askinan? beyisrael meshummad.
Ta shema: hametamme vehamedammea vehamenassech, beshogeg – patur, bemezid – chayyayv. hacha name beyisrael meshummad.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: hitru bo vekibbel alav hateraa, may? amar leh: hittir atzmo lemita kaamrat? en lach meshummad gadol mizze.

Mishna en shochatin lo letoch yammim, velo letoch neharot, velo letoch kelim, aval shochet hu letoch uga shel mayim. uvisfina, al gabbe chelim. en shochatin laggumma kol ikkar, aval ose gumma betoch beto bishvil sheyyikkanes haddam letochah. uvashshuk lo yaase ken, shello
b: Yechakke et hamminin.
Gemara en shochatin lo letoch vechulei. may shena letoch yammim dela? deamri: lesara deyamma ka shachet. letoch uga shel mayim name amri: levavua ka shachet. amar rava: baachurim shanu.
En shochatin laggumma vechulei. veha amrat: en shochatin laggumma kelal? amar abbaye: resha begumma shebbashshuk.
Amar leh rava: veha middekatane sefa "uvashshuk lo yaase ken", mikkelal deresha lav beshuk askinan!

Ella amar rava, hachi kaamar: en shochatin laggumma kol ikkar, veharotze lenakker chatzero, ketzad hu ose? ose makom chutz laggumma veshochet, vedam shotet veyored laggumma, uvashshuk lo yaase ken, shello yechakke et hamminin.
Tanya kevavteh derava: haya mehallech bisfina veen lo makom bassefina lishchot – motzi yado chutz lassefina veshochet, vedam shotet veyored al dofne hassefina, veen shochet laggumma kol ikkar.

Veharotze lenakker chatzero, ketzad hu ose? ose makom chutz laggumma veshochet, vedam shotet veyored laggumma. uvashshuk lo yaase ken, mishshum shenneemar: "uvechukkotehem lo telechu", veim asa ken – tzarich bedika acharav.
Mishna hashshochet leshem ola, leshem zevachim, leshem asham taluy, leshem pesach, leshem toda – shechitato pesula, verabbi shimon machshir.

Shenayim ochazin besakkin veshochatin, echad leshum echad mikkol ellu, veechad leshum davar kasher – shechitato pesula. hashshochet leshem chattat, leshem asham vadday, leshem bechor, leshem maaser, leshem temura – shechitato keshera.
Ze hakkelal: kol davar shenniddar veniddav – hashshochet lishmo asur, vesheeno niddar veniddav – hashshochet lishmo kasher.
Gemara hashshochet leshem ola. asham taluy bar niddar veniddav hu? amar rabbi yochanan: ha manni? rabbi elazar hi, deamar: mitnaddev adam asham taluy bechol yom.
Pesach bar niddav veniddar hu? zimna kevia leh! amar rabbi oshaya: shane pesach, hoil vehaferashato kol hashshana kullah.
Amar rabbi yannay: lo shanu ella temimim, aval baale mumin – midda yedia. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu baale mumin name, zimnin dirme leh midde ammuma vela yedia.

Hashshochet leshem chattat, amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella sheeno mechuyyayv chattat, aval mechuyyayv chattat – ema leshum chattato hu ose. veha la kaamar "leshem chattati"? amar rabbi avahu: beomer "leshem chattati".

Leshem temura, amar rabbi elazar: lo shanu ella sheen lo zevach betoch beto, aval yesh lo zevach betoch beto – ema amore amayr beh. veha la kaamar "leshem temurat zivchi"? amar rabbi avahu: beomer "leshem temurat zivchi".
"Ze hakkelal" leetoye may? leetoye olat nazir, demahu detema: ha la nedar, emar neder betzina.
Vesheeno niddar veniddav, leetoye olat yoledet.
Amar rabbi elazar: lo shanu ella sheen lo ishsha, aval yesh lo ishsha – emar lishmah hu ose. veha la kaamar "leshem olat ishti"? amar rabbi avahu: beomer "leshem olat ishti".
Peshita?

a: Mahu detema: im ita deyalda – kala hava leh, ka mashma lan: emar appole appil.
Hadaran alach hashshochet.

Mishna ellu terefot babbehema: nekuvat havvevshet, ufesukat haggargeret, nikkav kerum shel moach, nikkav hallev levet chalalo, nishbera hashshidra venifsak hachut shellah, nittal hakkaved velo nishtayyer hemennu kelum.

Harea shennikkeva o shechasra, rabbi shimon omer: ad shettinnakev levet hassimponot. nikkeva hakkeva, nikkeva hammara, nikkevu haddakkin, hakkares happenimit shennikkeva o shennikra rov hachitzona. rabbi yehuda omer: haggedola tefach, vehakketanna berubbah. hemses uvet hakkosot shennikkevu lachutz.

Nafla min haggag, nishtabberu rov tzaloteha, uderusat hazzeev. rabbi yehuda omer: derusat hazzeev baddakka, uderusat ari baggassa, derusat hannetz beof haddak, uderusat haggas beof haggas. ze hakkelal: kol sheen kamoha chayya – terefa.

Gemara amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: remez litrefa min hattora minnayin? minnayin?! "uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu"! ella, remez litrefa sheenah chayya min hattora minnayin? dekatane sefa: ze hakkelal, kol sheen kamoha chayya – terefa, mikkelal ditrefa enah chayya, mena lan?
Dichtiv: "vezot hachayya asher tochlu", chayya – echol, sheenah chayya – la techul, mikkelal ditrefa lo chayya.
Uleman deamar terefa chayya, mena leh? nafka leh mizzot hachayya asher tochlu" – "zot hachayya" echol, chayya acheret la techol, mikkelal ditrefa chayya.

Veiddach, hay "zot" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael, detana deve rabbi yishmael: "zot hachayya asher tochlu" – melammed shettafas hakkadosh baruch hu mikkol min umin vehera lo lemoshe, veamar lo: zot echol, vezot la techol.

Veiddach name mibbee leh lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael! in hachi name, ella terefa chayya mena leh? nafka leh meiddach tana deve rabbi yishmael, detana deve rabbi yishmael: "ben hachayya hanneechelet uven hachayya asher lo teachel" – ellu shemone esre terefot shenneemru lemoshe missinay.
Vetu lekka? veha ikka 265, veshav shematata!
b: Bishlama letanna didan, ditna, tena udeshayyayr – atya beze hakkelal, ella letanna deve rabbi yishmael deamar: shemone esre terefot vetu lekka, veha ikka behema shennechtechu ragleha min haarkubba ulemala terefa? savar leh kerabbi shimon ben elazar, deamar: yechola hi likkovot velichyot.
Af al gav dichola likkovot velichyot, leman kaamar? letanna deve rabbi yishmael, tanna deve rabbi yishmael terefa chayya sevira leh! ella savar la kerabbi shimon ben elazar, deamar: "keshera hi".
Vehaikka chissaron bashshidra, ditnan: kamma chissaron bashshidra? bet shammay omrim: shete chuleyot, uvet hillel omrim: chuleya achat; veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: vechen litrefa.
Hemses uvet hakkosot, deka chashvat lehu betarte, chashvinhu bachada, appek chada veayyel chada.
Vehaikka geluda? savar la kerabbi meir demachshayr.
Veha ikka charuta? mara – man katane la? rabbi yose berabbi yehuda. appek mara, veayyel charuta.

Vehaikka shav shematata, deamar rav matna: hay buka deatma deshaf midducheteh – terefa, veamar rachish bar pappa mishshemeh derav: lakta bechuleya achat – terefa, utenan: nittal hattechol – keshera, veamar rav avvira mishshemeh derava: lo shanu ella nittal, aval nikkav – terefa.

Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar shemuel: simanim shenniddaldelu berubban – terefa. veamar rabba bar rav shela amar rav matna amar shemuel: neekra tzela meikkarah – terefa, vegulegolet shennechbesa berubba, uvasar hachofe et rov hakkares berubbo – terefa.
Nekuve temanya havu, chashvinhu bechad, appek shav, veayyel shav.
I hachi, pesuke name tere havu, chashshevinhu bechad, batzar lehu chada, veod, derav avvira mishshemeh derava name nekuva hi!

a: Ella hanach tarte deappekt, la tappek.
Amar ulla: shemona mine terefot neemru lo lemoshe besinay – nekuva, ufesuka, netula, vachasura, kerua, uderusa, nefula, ushevura. leappoke lakuta derachish bar pappa.

Amar chiyyay bar rava: shemona terefot yesh binkuva, im tomar tesha – mara rabbi yose berabbi yehuda katane la, detanya: nikkeva hakkeva, nikkevu haddakkim – terefa, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: af nikkeva hammara.
(Hilchot chaver kezayit mara vekurekvan – siman).
Amar rabbi yitzchak berabbi yosef amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak berabbi yosef amar rabbi yochanan: may ahdaru leh chavreh lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda? "yishpoch laaretz merarati", vaadayin iyyov kayyaym. amar lahem: en mazkirin maase nissim, dei la tema hachi "yefallach kilyotay velo yachmol" – mi ka chaye? ella nissa shane, dichtiv: "rak et nafsho shemor". hacha name nissa shane.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak berabbi yosef amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kedivre haomer kezayit.

Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna, utenan: nittela hakkaved velo nishtayyer hemenna kelum – ha nishtayyer keshera, af al gav dela have kezayit! amorae ninhu veallibba derabbi yochanan.
Deamar rabbi yitzchak berabbi yosef amar rabbi yochanan: mara shennikkeva, vechaved sotamtah – keshera.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak berabbi yosef amar rabbi yochanan: nikkav hakkurekvan vechis shello kayyaym – kasher.

Ibbaya lehu: nikkav hakkis vekurekvan kayyaym, may? ta shema, deamar rav nachman: nikkav ze belo ze – kasher. amar rava: shene orot yesh lo lavvevshet, chitzon adom ufenimi lavan, nikkav ze belo ze – kasher. lema li lememar chitzon adom ufenimi lavan? dei challef – terefa.

Ibbaya lehu: nikkevu shenehem ze shello keneged ze, mahu? amar mar zutera mishshemeh derav pappa: bavvevshet – kasher, bakkurekvan – pasul. matkef la rav ashe: adderabba, vevshet deachla beh ufaya beh ravavch, gamda leh ufashta leh, zimnin demihandezin bahade hadade; kurekvan demenach nayaych, kidkae kae! amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav ashe: hachi amrinan mishshemeh demar zutera, deamar mishshemeh derav pappa kevavtaych.
Veamar rabba: kerum sheala mechamat makka bavvevshet, eno kerum. veamar rabba: vevshet en lo bedika mibbachutz, ella bifnim. lemay nafka minna?
b: Lisfek derusa.

Hahi sefek derusa daatay lekammeh derabba, hava ka badek leh rabba levevshet meabbaray. amar leh abbaye: veha mar hu deamar: vevshet en lo bedika ella mibbifnim! afcheh rabba uvadkeh, veishtechach aleh tere kurete dema, vetarfa. verabba name lechaddode leabbaye hu devae.
Amar ulla: yashav lo kotz bavvevshet, en choshshin shemma hivri.
(Daras chatichot besakkin temea, siman)
Uleulla, may shena missefek derusa? kasavar ulla en choshshin lisfek derusa.
Umay shena mishshete chatichot, achat shel chelev veachat shel shumman? hatam ittachzak issura.
Umay shena mehashshochet besakkin, venimtzet peguma? hatam ityeylid la reuta besakkin.
Umay shena missefek tumea birshut hayyachid, disfeko tame? velitamaych, nidammeyeh lisfek tumea birshut harabbim, disfeko tahor! ella hatam, hilcheta gemiri la missota.

Yatev hahu merabbanan kammeh derav kahana, veyatev vekaamar: "nimtzet" ittemar, aval yashav – chayyshinan. amar lehu rav kahana: la tetzitu leh, "yashav" ittemar, aval nimtzet – la itzterich leh leulla, dechullehu cheve barayayta kotze achlan.
Ittemar: turebatz havvevshet – rav amar: bemashshehu, ushemuel amar: berubbo. rav amar bemashshehu: mekom shechita hu, ushemuel amar berubbo: lav mekom shechita hu.

He nihu turebatz havvevshet? amar mari bar mar ukeva amar shemuel: kol shechotcho umarchiv – ze hu turebatz havvevshet, chotcho veomed bimkomo – zehu vevshet atzmo. amar lehu rav pappe: mar la amar hachi, umannu? rav bivi bar abbaye. ella kol shechotcho veomed bimkomo – ze turebatz havvevshet, ella ezehu vevshet atzmo? kol shechotcho vechavetz. yona amar zera: mavlata, vechamma? amar rav avya: pachut missearta vaadif mechitteta.
Hahu tora dahava livne rav ukeva, deatchel beh shechita beturebatz havvevshet, ugemar bevevshet. amar rava: ramena aleh chumere derav vechumere dishmuel, vetarefna leh.
Chumere derav, deamar rav: bemashshehu. vehaamar rav: mekom shechita hu! kishmuel, deamar: lav mekom shechita hu. i shemuel, haamar: berubbo! kerav, deamar: bemashshehu.
Iggalgal milleta, metay lekammeh derabbi abba, amar lehu: tora, ben lerav ben lishmuel shere. zilu amaru leh livreh derav yosef bar chama, dilshallem deme tora lemareh.

Amar mar bereh deravina: motvina teyuveta kelappe saneh derava, leolam hilcheta kedivre bet hillel, veharotze laasot kedivre bet shammay – ose, kedivre bet hillel – ose. mikkulle bet shammay umikkulle bet hillel – rasha.

a: Mechumere bet shammay umechumere bet hillel – alav hakkatuv omer: "hakkesil bachoshech holech". ella i kevet shammay – kekullehen uchechumerehen, i kevet hillel – kekullehen uchechumerehen.
Ha gufa kashya, amrat: leolam halacha kedivre bet hillel, vahadar tane: veharotze laasot kedivre bet shammay yaase!
La kashya, kan – kodem bat kol, kan – leachar bat kol.
Vei baet ema, af leachar bat kol, verabbi yehoshua hi, deamar: en mashgichin bevat kol.
Mikkol makom, kashya.

Amar rav tavut: kulla kerav avda, dechi ata rame bar yechezkel amar: la tetzitu lehu lehane kelale dechayel yehuda achi mishshemeh derav! hachi amar rav: vevshet natnu [bo] chachamim shiur, mikkelal deturebatz havvevshet lav mekom shechita hu, vekaamar bemashshehu.
Lemala ad kamma? amar rav nachman: ad kede tefisat yad. lematta ad kamma? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: ad kede sheyyasir.
Ini? vehaamar ravina amar geniva mishshemeh derav: tefach bavvevshet samuch lakkares – zehu kares happenimi. ammay? ki ka shachet bechares ka shachet!
Ema: tefach bechares samuch lavvevshet – zehu kares happenimi. ibbaet ema: ki kaamar rav – betora, demasar tefe.
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel: turebatz havvevshet shennittal kullo millechi – kasher, utena tuna: nittal lechi hattachton – kasher.
Matkef la rav pappa: vehaikka ikkur simanim?
Ulerav pappa kashya matnitin: nittal lechi hattachton – kasher.
Bishlama matnitin lerav pappa la kashya, ha deiakur iakore, ha deiggum iggome meillave simanim, ella lishmuel kashya!
La tema kullo, ella ema rubbo.
Vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar shemuel: simanim shenniddaldelu berubban – terefa? amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: ha deikkefal ikkefole, hatam deipperuk ipperoke.
Ufesukat haggargeret. tana: kamma pesukat haggargeret? berubbah. vechamma rubba? rav amar:
b: Rov ovyah, veamri la: rov chalala.

Hahi pesukat haggargeret daatay lekammeh derav, yatev veka badek la berov ovyah. amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav: limmadtanu rabbenu berov chalalah! shaddereh lekammeh derabba bar bar chana, badka berov chalalah veachshera, uzevan minna bitlesar istere peshite bisra.
Vehechi aved hachi? vehatanya: chacham shettimme – en chavero rashshay letaher, asar – en chavero rashshay lehattir! shane hacha, derav la asar mesar.
Vechevan deori ba chacham, hechi achal minna? veha ketiv: "vaomar ahah Adonai elohim hinne nafshi lo metummaa unevela uterefa lo achalti minneuray vead atta velo va befi besar piggul".

"Hinne nafshi lo metummaa" – shello hirharti bayyom lavo lide tumea ballayla, "unevela uterefa lo achalti" – shello achalti besar "kos kos" meolam, "velo va befi besar piggul" – shello achalti mibbehema shehora bah chacham. mishshum rabbi natan amru: shello achalti mibbehema shello huremu mattenoteha.
Hane mille – milleta detalya bisvara, rabba bar bar chana aggemareh semach.

Vetippok leh mishshum chashada, detanya: dan et haddin, zikka vechayyayv, timme vetiher, asar vehittir, vechen haedim sheheidu – kullan rashshain likkach, aval amru chachamim: harechek min hakkiur umin haddome lo.
Hane mille midde dimzabben mishshuma, hacha matkela mochach, ki ha derabba shera terefta uzevan minna bisra, amara leh bat rav chisda: abba share buchera vela zaven minneh bisra.
Amar la: hane mille buchera deashshuma mizdevan, hacha matkela mochach, may ikka – mishshum umetza meallayyta? kol yoma umetza meallayyta zabbinu li.
Amar rav chisda: ezehu talmid chacham? ze haroe terefa leatzmo. veamar rav chisda: ezehu "sone mattanot yichye"? ze haroe terefa leatzmo.

Daresh mar zutera mishshemeh derav chisda: kol mi shekkore veshone, veroe terefa leatzmo, veshimmesh talmide chachamim – alav hakkatuv omer: "yegia kappecha ki tochel ashrecha vetov lach". rav zevid amar: zoche venochel shene olamot, haolam hazze vehaolam habba, "ashrecha" – beolam hazze, "vetov lach" – laolam habba.

Rabbi elazar, ki havo meshadderi leh mibbe nesia midde, la shakel, vechi havo mezammeni leh, la azel. amar: la ka bae mar deeche? dichtiv: "vesone mattanot yichye". rabbi zera, ki meshadderi leh, la shakel, ki havo mazmenin leh, azel. amar:

a: Ityaykkore hu demityaykkeru bi.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: nikkeva kenafa – mitztarfim lerubba.

Metiv rav yirmeya: uvegulegolet sheyyesh bah nekev echad aroch, afillu yesh bah nekavim harebe – mitztarfim limlo makdeach. alma, kevan deshiura melo makdeach – limlo makdeach mitztarfin. hacha name, kevan deshiureh keissar – lichissar mitztarfin.
Ishtemitteh ha deamar rabbi chelbo amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: nekavim sheyyesh bahen chesron mitztarfin lichissar, vesheen bahen chesron mitztarfin lerubba.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: nittela hemenna retzua – mitztarefet lichissar. bea minneh rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani merabbi yehoshua ben levi: nikkeva kenafa mahu? amar leh: hare amru: nekavim sheyyesh bahen chissaron – mitztarfin lichissar, vesheen bahen chissaron – mitztarfin lerubba.
Beofa may?

Amar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derabbi elazar: mekappelo umannicho al pi hakkane, im chofe et rov hakkane – terefa, veim lav – keshera. amar rav pappa: vesimanaych – nafya.
Nifchata kedelet, amar rav nachman: kede sheyyikkanes issar lerochbo. nisdeka, amar rav: afillu lo nishtayyer bah ella chuleya achat lemala vechuleya achat lematta – keshera.
Amruha kammeh derabbi yochanan, amar: ma chuleya uma chuleya dekaamar rav? ella ema: afillu lo nishtayyer bah ella mashshehu lemala umashshehu lematta – keshera.
Amruha kammeh derabbi yochanan mishshemeh derabbi yonatan hachi, amar lehu: yadin chavrin bavlae lefaroshe ki hay tama?

Tane rabbi chiyyay bar yosef kammeh derabbi yochanan: kol hatztzavvar kullo kasher lishchita, mittabbaat haggedola ad kanfe rea hattachtona. amar rava: tachtona shehi elyona, sheani omer kol shepposhetet tzavvarah veroa, uvilvad shello teanes.

Bae rav chanina, veittema rav chananya: ansa atzmah mahu? teku. yatev rabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish, nefak milleta mibbenayyhu: anas bassimanim veshachat – pesula. nikkav hakkane lematta min hechaze – niddon kerea.
Tanu rabbanan: ezehu chaze? ze haroe et hakkarka, lematta – ad hatztzavvar, lemala – ad hakkares. chotech shete tzelaot mishshete defanot elach veelach, vezehu chaze hannittan lakkohanim.

Nikkav kerum shel moach. rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: kerama illaa, af al gav dela innekiv tattaa. veamri la: ad deinnekiv tattaa. amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani: vesimanaych chayyta demittenach beh mocha.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kenegdo babbetzim nikkar. amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: moach – kol ma shebbakkedera niddon kemoach, hitchil limmashech niddon kechut hashshidra. umehechan matchil limmashech? amar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derabbi yehoshua ben levi – kemin shene
b: Polin yesh munnachin al pi hakkedera, min happolin velifnim – kelifnim, min happolin velachutz – kelachutz, ufolin atzman eni yodea. umistabbera kelifnim.
Rabbi yirmeya bedak beofa, veashkach kemin shene polin munnachin al pi hakkedera.

Nikkav hallev levet chalalo, bae rabbi zera: levet chalal katan o levet chalal gadol? amar leh abbaye: may tibbee lach? mi la tenan: rabbi shimon omer "ad shettinnakev levet hassimponot", veamar rabba bar tachlifa amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rav: ad shettinnakev lesimpon gadol.
Hachi hasheta? hatam levet hassimponot katane, lehecha deshafchi simponot kullehu, vehacha levet chalalo katane – ma li chalal gadol, ma li chalal katan!
Kene hallev, rav amar: bemashshehu, ushemuel amar: berubbo.
He nihu kene hallev? amar rabba bar yitzchak amar rav: chelev sheal gabbe defanot. defanot salka datach? ella: sheal gabbe dofne rea.
Amar ammemar mishshemeh derav nachman: telata kene havu, chad paresh lelibba, vechad paresh lerea, vechad paresh lechavda. derea – kerea, dechavda – kechavda, delibba – peligi.
Mar bar chiyyay matni ippecha: derea – kechavda, dechavda – kerea, delibba – peligi.
Azal rabbi chiyyay bar yosef amra lishmata derav kammeh dishmuel, amar leh: i hachi amar abba – la yada bitrefot velo kelum.
(Nishbar) [nishbera] hashshidra, tanu rabbanan: chut hashshidra shennifsak berubbo – divre rabbi; rabbi yaakov omer: afillu nikkav.
Hora rabbi kerabbi yaakov. amar rav huna: en halacha kerabbi yaakov.
Vechamma rubbo? rav amar: rov oro, veamri la: rov mocho.
Man deamar rov mocho – kol shekken rov oro, leman deamar rov oro – rov mocho may?
Ta shema, deamar nivli amar rav huna: rubbo sheamru – rov oro, moach ze – lo maale velo morid.
Rav natan bar avin hava yatev kammeh derav, bedak berov oro, veka badek berov mocho. amar leh: im rov oro kayyaym, moach ze eno maale veeno morid.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: nitmarech – pasul, nitmasmes – pasul. ezohi hameracha veezohi hamasmasa? hameracha – kol shennishpach kekiton, (masemaseh) [hamasmasa] – kol sheeno yachol laamod.

Bae rabbi yirmeya: eno yachol laamod mippene kovdo, may? teku. be rav amri: nitmasmes – pasul, nitmazmez – kasher. metivi: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: behema shennitmazmez mocha – terefa! hahi nitmasmes ittemar.
Ini, veha levi hava yatev be massuta, chazyeh lehahu gavra detaryeh leresheh, amar: nitmazmez mocheh deden, lav dela chaye? amar abbaye: la, lomar sheeno molid.
Ad hechan chut hashshidra? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: ad ben happarashot.

Rav dimi bar yitzchak hava ka bae lemezal leve chozae, ata lekammeh derabbi yehuda, amar leh: laychve li mar ben happarashot hecha? amar leh: zil ayyti li gedi veachvi lach. ayyti leh gedi shamen, amar leh: belian tefe vela yedia. ayyti leh kachush, amar leh: belitan tefe vela yedia.
Amar leh: ta agmerach gemara, hachi amar shemuel: ad achat – terefa, shelishit – keshera, sheniyya – eni yodea.
Bae rav huna bereh derav yehoshua:

a: Ad vead bakkelal, o dilma ad velo ad bakkelal?
Bae rav pappa: im timtze lomar, ad velo ad bakkelal, pi farasha mahu?
Bae rabbi yirmeya: im timtze lomar, ad vead bakkelal, parasha atzmah mahu?
Ta shema: happarasha tiddon kevasar. may lav parasha rishona usheniyya? la, shelishit.
Beofa, rabbi yannay omer: lematta min haagappayim, veresh lakish amar: ad ben agappayim.

Amar ulla: hava kaemna kammeh deven pazzi, veayyto lekammeh ofa, uvedak ad ben agappayim, ushelach leh deve nesia vekam vaazal, vela yadana i mishshum dela tzerich lemivdak tefe, i mishshum kevod nesia.
Nittela hakkaved vechulei. ha nishtayyer hemenna kelum – keshera, af al gav dela have kezayit, vehatnan: nittal hakkaved venishtayyer hemenna kezayit – keshera!
Amar rav yosef: la kashya, ha rabbi chiyyay, ha rabbi shimon bar rabbi, ki ha derabbi chiyyay zarek la, verabbi shimon bar rabbi metabbel la, vesimanaych: "ashirin mekammetzin".

Hahu pulemusa daata lefumebdita, araku rabba verav yosef, pega behu rabbi zera, amar lehu: arokae, kezayit sheamru bimkom mara. rav adda bar ahava amar: bimkom shehi chayya. amar rav pappa: hilkach, baenan kezayit bimkom mara, uvaenan kezayit bimkom shehi chayya.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: mitlakket, mahu? kirtzua, mahu? bae rav ashe: kezayit meruddad, mahu? teku.

Bea minneh rabbi zerika merabbi amme: niddaldela kaved umeora betarpesheha, mahu? amar leh: dildul ze eni yodea mahu, i leman deamar bimkom mara – ha ikka, i leman deamar bimkom shehi chayya – ha ikka.
Harea shennikkeva, rav ushemuel verav assi deamri: kerama illaa, veamri la: kerama tattaa. amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: vesimanaych kittuna devarda demannecha beh rea.
Peshita: i innekiv illaa vela innekiv tattaa – tattaa megen, kidrabba, deamar rabba: hay rea deiggelid
b: Kaahina summaka – keshera. innekiv tattaa vela innekiv illaa – maggen o la maggen?

Peligi ba rav acha veravina, chad amar: la maggen, vechad amar: maggen. vehilcheta maggen, kidrav yosef, deamar rav yosef: hay rea deavvsha, i yadinan hecha avvsha – motvinan ala gadpa o rukka o gila, i mevatzbetza – terefa, vei la – keshera. vei la yadinan hecha avvsha – mayytinan meshichleta demayya pashore umotvinan la begavva.

Bechammime la – dechavvtzi, bekarire la – dimtarshi, ella motvinan befashore venafchinan la. i mevatzbetza – terefa, vei la – keshera. tattaa innekiv, illaa la innekiv, vehay deavvsha – zika devene bene hu.
(Ahine summaka divash gilde, siman).
Gufa, amar rava: hay rea deiggelid kaahina summaka – keshera. veamar rava: rea sheheedima miktzatah – keshera, kullah – terefa.
Amar leh ravina lerava: miktzatah may tama? dehadra barya, kullah name hadra barya! mi la tanya: ushear shekatzim uremasim, ad sheyyetze mehem dam.
Vechi tema: lishmona sheratzim medammenan la, detanya: nitzrar haddam, af al pi shello yatza. i hachi, afillu miktzatah name! ella, la shena.
Veamar rava: rea sheyyavsha miktzatah – terefa. vechamma? amar rav pappi mishshemeh derava: keday shettipparech betzipporen.
Keman, kerabbi yose ben hameshullam? detanya: ezo hi yevesha – sheim tinnakev veenah motzia tippat dam; rabbi yose ben hameshullam omer: yevesha kede shettehe nifrechet betzipporen.

Afillu tema rabbanan, gabbe ozen bechor deka shalet beh zika – la hadra barya, aval rea dela ka shalet ba avvera – hadra barya. veamar rava: hay rea dekayyma gilde gilde, ukkame ukkame, chezvavta chezvavta – keshera.
Amar ammemar mishshemeh derava: en makkifin bevue.
Veamar rava: hane tarte unne disrichan lahadade, let lehu bedika. vela amaran ella shello kesidran, aval kesidran – hayeynu revitayyhu.

a: Veamar rava: hane tarte bue dismichan lahadade, let lehu bedikuta. chada umitchazya ketarte – mayytinan silva uvazinan la, i shafchan lahadade – chada hi ucheshera, vei la – tarte ninhu uterefa.
Veamar rava: chamesh unne it la lerea, appa kelappe gavra – telata miyyammina vetarte missemala. chassir o yattir o chalif – terefa.

Hahu yattirta daatay lekammeh demarimar, hava yatev rav acha abbava. amar leh: may amar lach? amar leh: achshera nihali. amar leh: hadar ayyeyla kammeh! amar leh: zil ema leh leman deyatev abbava, let hilcheta kevavteh derava biteret.
Vehane mille – dekayyma bedara deunne, aval bene bene – terefa.

Hahu bene bene daata lekammeh derav ashe, savar rav ashe lemitrefa. amar leh rav huna mar bar avya: kol hane cheve barayayta hachi it lehu, vekaru la tabbache enunita devavrda. vehane mille miggavvay,
b: Aval aggabba, afillu ketarpa deasa – terefa.
Amar rafram: hay rea dedamya leufeta – terefa. ikka deamri bachazuta, veikka deamri begishta. ikka deamri dinficha, veikka deamri difchiza, veikka deamri deshia, delet la chittucha deunne.
Amar rava: kechuchela – keshera, kidyota – terefa, deamar rabbi chanina: shachor adom hu, ella shellaka.

Yerukka – keshera, midderabbi natan. adumma – keshera, midderabbi natan. detanya: rabbi natan omer: paam achat halachti lichrakke hayyam, bata ishsha achat lefanay shemmala benah rishon vamet, sheni vamet, shelishi – heviattu lefanay. reitiv shehaya adom, amarti lah: bitti, hametini lo ad sheyyibbala bo damo. himtina lo umala oto vechaya, vehayu korin oto natan habbavli al shemi.

Veshuv paam achat halachti limdinat kappotkeya, bata ishsha lefanay, shemmala benah rishon vamet, sheni vamet, shelishi heviattu lefanay, reitiv shehaya yarok, hetzatzti bo velo haya bo dam berit, amarti lah: bitti, hametini lo ad sheyyippol bo damo, himtina lo umala oto vechaya, vehayu korin oto natan habbavli al shemi.
Amar rav kahana: kechavda – keshera, kevisra – terefa, vesimanaych: "uvasar bassade terefa".
Amar rav samma bereh derava: hay rea dedamya kichshuta, uchemorika, uchegon beata – terefa. ella yerukka dichshera hechi damya? kecharate.
Amar ravina: atum berea, mayytinan sakkina vekarinan la, i it ba mugela – vadday mechamat mugela hu, ucheshera, vei la – motvinan ala gadpa o rukka, i mevatzbetza – keshera, vei la – terefa.

Amar rav yosef: kerum sheala mechamat makka barea – eno kerum, veamar rav yosef: hay rea deavvsha, i yadinan hecha avvsha – mannechinan ala gadpa o gila o rukka, i mevatzbetza – terefa, vei la – keshera, vei la yadinan la – mayytinan meshichleta demayya pashore umotvinan la begavva.
Bechammime la – dechavvtzi, bekarire la – dimtarshi, ella badkinan la befashore. i mevatzbetza – terefa, vei la – keshera. tattaa innekiv, illaa la innekiv, vehay deavvsha – zika devene uvene hu.
Amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: rea shennishpecha kekiton, keshera. alma kasavar: chissaron mibbifnim la shemeh chissaron.
Etiveh rabbi abba leulla: "harea shennikkeva o shechasra". may chasra? ilema mibbachutz – hayeynu nikkeva! ella lav mibbifnim, ushema minna: chissaron mibbifnim shemeh chissaron!

La, leolam mibbachutz, udeka amrat hayeynu nikkeva – la tzericha lerabbi shimon, deamar: ad shettinnakev levet hassimponot. hane mille nekev delet beh chissaron, aval nekev deit beh chissaron – afillu rabbi shimon mode.
Rabbi chananya chalash, al legabbeh rabbi natan vechol gedole haddor, ayyto kammeh rea shennishpecha kekiton, veachshera.

Amar rava: vehu dekayymi simponot. amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: mena yadinan? amar leh: mayytinan tzaa dekuneya, veshafchinan la begavveh. i it ba shureyayke chivvare – terefa, vei la – keshera.
Amar rav nachman: rea shennimmoka ukerum shellah kayyaym – keshera. tanya name hachi: rea shennimmoka ukerum shellah kayyaym, afillu machzeket reviit – keshera. nittela

a: Shalpuchit shellah – keshera. hitlia kaved shellah – ze haya maase, vealu aleha bene asya shelosha regalim leyavne, leregel shelishi hittiruha lahem.
Amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: rea hassemucha laddofen – en choshshin lah, heelta tzemachim – choshshin lah. mar yehuda mishshemeh daavimi amar: echad ze veechad ze – choshshin lah.

Hechi avdinan? amar rava: ravin bar sheva asbera li, mayytinan sakkina dachalish pummeh umefarkinan la; i ikka reuta bedofen – talenan batar dofen, vei la – mechamat rea hi, uterefa, veaf al gav dela ka mappeka zika.

Rav nechemya bereh derav yosef badek la befashore. amar leh mar zutera bereh derav huna bereh derav pappe leravina: ha derav nechemya bereh derav yosef, attun aha matnitu la, anan adderava matnenan la, deamar rava: hane tarte unne derea disrichan lahadade let lehu bedikuta leachshore. rav nechemya bereh derav yosef badek la befashore.
Matkef la rav ashe: hay may? bishlama hacha talenan bedofen, ucheshera, aval hatam – i hay nekiv – terefa, vei hay nekiv – terefa.
Umi amar rav nachman hachi? vehaamar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: rea shennikkeva vedofen sotamtah – keshera! la kashya, hatam bimkom revita, hacha shello bimkom revita.
Vehecha mekom revita? chittuche deunne.

Gufa, amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: rea shennikkeva vedofen sotamtah – keshera. amar ravina: vehu disvich bevisra. amar leh rav yosef leravina: vei la sevich may? terefa, alma amrinan nekuva hi. i hachi, ki sevich name!
Deha tanya: nikkav – pasul, mippene shehu shotet; nistam – kasher, mippene shehu molid, vezehu pesul shechozer lehechshero. vezehu lemaote may? lav lemaote kehay gavvna.
La, lemaote kerum sheala mechamat makka barea, deeno kerum.
Matkef la rav ukeva bar chama: illu innekiv dofen lahada, may? terefa! litne nekuvat haddofen!
Velitamaych, ha deamar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: mara shennikkeva vechaved sotamtah – keshera, illu innekiv kaved lahada, may? terefa! litne: nekuvat hakkaved.
Ella, ki nikkeva delav minneh mittarfa – la katane; hacha name, kevan delav minneh mittarfa – la katane.

Bea minneh rabba bar bar chana mishshemuel: heelta tzemachin, mahu? amar leh: keshera. amar leh: af ani omer ken, ella shehattalmidim mizdannezin baddavar, deamar rav matna: malya mugela – terefa, mayim zakkim – keshera. amar leh: hahi bechuleya ittemar.

Rabbi yitzchak bar yosef hava kaazel batreh derabbi yirmeya beshuka detabbache, chazanhu lehanach dekayymin tzimche tzimche. amar leh: la bae mar umetza? amar leh: let li perite. amar leh: akkefan ana. amar leh: ma eeved lach, dechi atu lekammeh derabbi yochanan meshaddar lehu lekammeh derabbi yehuda berabbi shimon, demore ba mishshemeh derabbi elazar berabbi shimon lehettera, veleh la sevira leh.
Amar rava: ki hava mesaggenan batreh derav nachman beshuka
b: Degildae, veamri la beshuka derabbanan, chaze hanach dekayyman kande kande, vela amar lehu vela midde.
Rabbi amme verabbi assi havo chalfi beshuka ditverya, (chaze) [chazonhu] hanach dekayymi tinnare tinnare, vela amri lehu vela midde.
Ittemar: machat shennimtzet barea – rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar verabbi chanina machsheri, rabbi shimon ben lakish verabbi mani bar pattish verabbi shimon ben elyakim tarfi.

Lema beha kamippalgi, demar savar: chissaron mibbifnim – shemeh chissaron, umar savar: la shemeh chissaron? la, dechulle alma chissaron mibbifnim – la shemeh chissaron, vehacha beha kamippalgi: mar savar: simpona nekat vaatay, umar savar: nakkove nakkev vaatay.

Hahi machta deishtechach bechittucha derea, ayytuha lekammeh derabbi amme, sevar leachshora. etiveh rabbi yirmeya, veittema rabbi zerika: "harea shennikkeva o shechasra". may chasra? ilema mibbachutz – hayeynu nikkeva! ella lav mibbifnim, ushema minna: chissaron mibbifnim – shemeh chissaron.

Hadar shadderuha lekammeh derabbi yitzchak nappacha, sevar leachshora, etiveh rabbi yirmeya, veittema rabbi zerika: "harea shennikkeva o shechasra". may chasra? ilema mibbachutz – hayeynu nikkeva! ella lav mibbifnim? ushema minna: chissaron mibbifnim – shemeh chissaron!

Hadar shadderuha lekammeh derabbi amme vetarfa. amri leh: veha rabbanan machsheri? amar lahen: hen hichshiru, sheyyodim meeze taam hichshiru, anu meeze taam nachshir? dilma i hava rea kamman minnakva.
Tama deleta, ha ita vela minnakva – keshera, vehaamar rav nachman: hay simpona derea deinnekiv – terefa, hahu lachavero ittemar.

Vehaamar rav nachman: hay hadora dechanta deinnekiv lahade chavreh – maggen aleh, amar rav ashe: terefot ka medamme lahadade? en omrin bitrefot zo doma lazo, shehare chotchah mikkan umeta, chotchah mikkan vechayya!

Hahi machta deishtechach besimpona rabba derea, atyuha lekamme derabbanan tarofae, la amaru bah la issur vela hetter. hetter la amri ba – kishmatayyhu, issur name la amri ba – kevan divsimpona rabba ishtechach, ema simpona nekat vaatay.

Hahi machta deishtechach bachaticha dechavda, sevar mar bereh derav yosef lemitrefa, amar leh rav ashe: illu ishtechach bevisra kehay gavvna hava taref mar? ella amar rav ashe: chazena, i kofa levar – nakkove nakkev vaatay, i kofa legav – simpona nekat vaatay.
Vehane mille beallimta, aval kattinta, la shena kofa legav, la shena kofa levar, nakkove nakkev vaatay.
Umay shena mimmachat shennimtzet

a: Beovi bet hakkosot mitztzad echad keshera, mishshene tzedadin terefa, vela amrinan lichze i kofa levar i kofa legav?
Amri: hatam, kevan deikka ochalim umashkim – ema ochalim umashkim dachkuha.
Hahu machta deishtechach besimpona rabba dechavda, huna mar bereh derav idi taref, rav adda bar minyome machshar. ato shayylu leravina, amar lehu: shekilu gelima detarofae.

Hahi keshita deishtechach bemara, amar rav ashe: ki havenan be rav kahana, amar: ha vadday simpona nekat vaatay, af al gav dela ka nafka, mirbal hu deravel lay, vehane mille dedikla, aval dezeta mivza baza.
Amar rabbi yochanan: lamma nikra shemah rea – shemmeira et haenayim. ibbaya lehu: laachila, o al yede sammanin?
Ta shema, deamar rav huna bar yehuda: avavza bezuza, verea dida bearbea. vei salka datach laachila – linkot bezuza velechol! ella, al yede sammanin.
Innakva rea hecha dimmashmesha yedeh detabbacha, talenan o la talenan? rav adda bar natan amar: talenan, mar zutera bereh derav mari amar: la talenan, vehilcheta: talenan.
Amar rav shemuel bereh derabbi avahu: abba mereshe kalle derafram hava, vaamar: talenan. amruha kammeh leha demar zutera bereh derav mari, vela kabbela.
Amar rav mesharsheya: kevavteh daavu deabba mistabbera, deha talenan bizev.
Murena, peligi ba rav yosef bar dosay verabbanan, chad amar: kodem shechita paresh, vechad amar: leachar shechita paresh, vehilcheta: leachar shechita paresh.
Rabbi shimon omer: ad shettinnakev. amar rabba bar tachlifa amar rav yirmeya bar abba: ad shettinnakev lesimpon gadol.

Yatev rav acha bar abba kammeh derav huna, veyatev vekaamar: amar rabbi malluch amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha kerabbi shimon. amar leh: malluch arvaa kaamrat? en halacha kerabbi shimon kaamar!

Ki salek rabbi zera, ashkecheh lerav bivi deyatev vekaamar: amar rabbi malluch amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha kerabbi shimon. amar leh: chayye demar, daana verabbi chiyyay bar abba verav assi ikkalinan leatreh derabbi malluch, vaamari leh: i amar mar halacha kerabbi shimon? vaamar lan: en halacha kerabbi shimon amari. veat ma bidach? amar leh: hachi amar rabbi yitzchak bar amme amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha kerabbi shimon.
Veen halacha kerabbi shimon.

Nikkeva hakkeva. amar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani amar rabbi oshaya: chelev sheal gabbe keva – kohanim nahagu bo hetter, kerabbi yishmael sheamar mishshum avotav. vesimanaych: "yishmael kahana mesayyay kahane".

May hi? detanya: "ko tevarchu et bene yisrael", rabbi yishmael omer: lamadnu beracha leyisrael mippi kohanim, lechohanim atzman lo lamadnu. keshehu omer: "vaani avarchem" – heve omer: kohanim mevarchin leyisrael, vehakkadosh baruch hu mevarech lakkohanim.
Rabbi akiva omer: lamadnu beracha leyisrael mippi chohanim, mippi gevura lo lamadnu. keshehu omer "vaani avarchem" – heve omer: kohanim mevarchin leyisrael, vehakkadosh baruch hu maskim al yadam.
Ella rabbi akiva, beracha lechohanim mena leh? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: mivvaavarcha mevarchecha".
Umay mesayyay kahane? demoke le levirkat kohanim bimkom beracha deyisrael.
Rabbi yishmael sheamar mishshum avotav, may hi? detanya: "et kol hachelev asher al hakkerev
b: Vegomer" – lehavi chelev sheal gabbe haddakkin, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: lehavi chelev sheal gabbe hakkeva.

Ureminhi: "et hachelev asher al hakkerev" – rabbi shimon omer: ma chelev hamechasse et hakkerev kerum veniklaf, af kol kerum veniklaf. rabbi akiva omer: ma chelev hamechasse et hakkerev totav kerum veniklaf, af kol totav kerum veniklaf.
Shelach ravin mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: kach hi hatztzaa shel mishna, veefoch kammayyta.
May chazet deafchat kammayyta? efoch batrayyta! shane hacha, kevan dekatane "ma", davvka.
I hachi, kerabbi yishmael? kerabbi akiva hi! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: sheamar mishshum avotav, veleh la sevira leh.
Amar rav: chelev tahor – sotem, tame – eno sotem. verav sheshet omer: echad ze veechad ze sotem.
Bae rabbi zera: chelev chayya may? davka amar chelev tahor sotem, vehay name tahor hu, o dilma mishshum dimhaddak, vehay la mehaddak?
Amar abbaye: may tibbee leh? nehi dishre baachila, ihaddoke la mehaddak.

Hahu nekev desatme chelev tame, daata lekammeh derava. amar rava: lemay nechush la? chada – deha amar rav sheshet: chelev tame name sotem, veod – hattora chasa al mamonam shel yisrael. amar leh rav pappa lerava: rav, veissura deorayyta, veat amrat "hattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael"?!

Minyomin kanduka iggalli leh busteka deduvesha, ata lekammeh derava. amar rava: lemay nechush la? chada – ditnan, shelosha mashkim asurim mishshum gilluy: hayyayin vehammayim vehechalav, ushear kol hammashkim muttarim, veod – hattora chasa al mamonam shel yisrael. amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava: rabbi shimon, vesakkanat nefashot, veat amrat "hattora chasa al mamonam shel yisrael"?

Rabbi shimon may hi? detanya: chamishsha en bahem mishshum gilluy: tzir, vachometz, shemen, udevash, umureyays. rabbi shimon omer: af hen yesh bahen mishshum gilluy. veamar rabbi shimon: ani raiti nachash sheshshata tzir betzaydan. amru lo: shatya hava, veen meviin reaya min hashshotim.

Amar leh: odi li mihat betzir, deha rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua verabbanan, ki hava lehu gilluya, shadu leh betzir. amar leh: odi li miha bidvash, derabbi shimon ben elazar kae kevavteh, detanya: vechen haya rabbi shimon ben elazar oser bidvash.
Amar rav nachman: chelev heasuy kechova eno sotem. hecha? amri la: chitte decharkesha, veamri la: tarpesha delibba.

Amar rava: shemait minneh derav nachman tarte, chimtza uvar chimtza, chad satem vechad la satem, vela yadana he minnayyhu. rav huna bar chinnana verav huna bereh derav nachman amar: bar chimtza satem, chimtza la satem. amar rav tavut: vesimanaych – yafe koach habben mikkoach haav.
He chimtza vehe bar chimtza? ta shema, deamar rav nachman: inhu mechol achli,

a: Uledidan mistam name la satem.
Deakkashta – kulle alma la peligi daasir, ki peligi – deayyitra.
Ikka deamri, deayyitra – kulle alma la peligi dishre, ki peligi – deakkashta.
Ki ha deamar rav avya amar rabbi amme: mekammetzin, vechen amar rabbi yannay mishshum zaken echad: mekammetzin. amar rav avya: hava kaemna kammeh derabbi amme, kematzu vehavu leh, vaachal.
Shammaeh derabbi chanina hava kae kammeh derabbi chanina, amar leh: kemotz, hav li deechol. chazyeh dahava kamchassem, amar leh: bavlaa at, gom shedi.
Tanya: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: bene meayin shennikkevu, velecha sotamtan – keshera. may lecha? amar rav kahana: shirka dimayyay denafek aggav ducheka.

Gemiri chavrayya derabbi abba merabbi abba, umannu? rabbi zera, veamri la chavrayya derabbi zera merabbi zera, umannu? rabbi abba. amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba: hachi amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel bitrefa, vahalacha kerabbi shimon beevel.
Halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel bitrefa – ha daamaran. kerabbi shimon beevel, may hi? ditnan: kol shelosha yamim harishonim, ba mimmakom karov – mone immahen.
Mimmakom rachok – mone leatzmo. mikkan veelach, afillu ba mimmakom karov – mone leatzmo. rabbi shimon omer: afillu beyom hashshevii, ba mimmakom karov – mone immahen.

Amar man dehu: izke veessak veegmera lishmata mippummeh demara. ki selek, ashkecheh lerabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba. amar leh: amar mar halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel bitrefa? amar leh: ha en halacha amari.
Kerabbi shimon beavel, may? amar leh: pelugata ninhu, deittemar: rav chisda amar halacha, vechen amar rabbi yochanan halacha, verav nachman amar en halacha.
Veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel bitrefa, vahalacha kerabbi shimon beevel, deamar shemuel: halacha kedivre hammekel beevel.
Amar rav shimi bar chiyyay: makkifim bivne meayim.

Hanhu bene meayim daato lekammeh derava, akkefinhu vela iddemo. ata rav mesharsheya bereh, memashmesh behu veiddemo. amar leh: mena lach ha? amar leh: kamma yede mashmishu behane mikkamme delete lekammeh demar. amar leh: chakkim beri bitrefot kerabbi yochanan.

Rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayyhu: makkifim barea. amar rava: la amaran ella beotah aruga, aval mearuga laaruga – la. vehilcheta: afillu mearuga laaruga, middakka ledakka, umiggassa legassa, aval lo miggassa ledakka, velo middakka legassa.

Abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: makkifin bakkane. amar rav pappa: la amaran ella beotah chuleya, aval mechuleya lechuleya – la. vehilcheta: afillu mechuleya lechuleya, umibbar chuleya levar chuleya, aval la mechuleya levar chuleya, vela mibbar chuleya lechuleya.
Amar zeeri: chalcholet shennikkeva keshera, hoil virechayim maamidot otah. vechamma? amar rabbi ilay amar rabbi yochanan: mekom haddevek – berubbo, shello bimkom haddevek – bemashshehu.
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derava mishshemeh derav nachman, amar: lav mi amena lechu la titlo beh
b: Buke seriki? hachi amar rav nachman: mekom haddevek, afillu nittal kullo – kasher, vehu shennishtayyer bo kede tefisa. vechamma? amar abbaye: kimle batda betora.

Hakkares happenimi. amar rav yehuda amar rav: heid natan bar shela resh tabbachayya detzippori lifne rabbi mishshum rabbi natan: e zo hi kares happenimi? sanya deve. vechen amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha: sanya deve. rabbi yishmael amar: istumecha decharsa.
Rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: makom tzar yesh bakkares, veeni yodea ezehu. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: nefal keresa bevera. amar rav acha bar rav avva amar rav assi: min hammetzar ulematta.
Rabbi yaakov bar nachmani amar shemuel: mekom sheen bo melat. rabbi avina amar geniva mishshemeh derav: tefach bavvevshet samuch lakkares – zo hi kares happenimit.

Amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi yose bar chanina: kol hakkares kullo – zo hi kares happenimit, veezehu kares hachitzon? basar hachofe et rov hakkares. rabba bar rav huna amar: mafrata. may mafrata? amar rav avya: hecha defari tabbache.
Binhardea avdi kerabba bar rav huna. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: kol hane shematata may? amar leh: kullehu shayychan bidrabba bar rav huna.
Uderav assi amar rabbi yochanan, may amar leh? kevar persha rav acha bar avva. uderabbi avina vedivne mareva, may amar leh? hane vadday peligi.

Rabbi yehuda omer: bigdola kulei. amar rabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi elazar: lo "gedola" – gedola mammash, velo "ketanna" – ketanna mammash, ella kol shennikra bah tefach vela have rubba – zo hi sheshshaninu: "bigdola tefach", rubba vela have tefach – zo hi sheshshaninu: "biktanna berubba".
Rubba vela have tefach, peshita! la tzericha, dehavya tefach bemashshehu, mahu detema: ad demikkera ba tefach la have terefa, ka mashma lan.

Amar geniva amar rabbi assi: nikdera kesela – terefa, sheim timmatach taamod al hattefach. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: ledidi mipparsha li minneh digniva ammabbara dinhardea – kesela keshera, yater mikkesela terefa. vechamma yater mikkesela? amar rav yosef: kegon deayylan telat kashyayta betzippa beducheka, bela tzippa beravvcha.
Hemses uvet hakkosot, tanu rabbanan: machat shennimtzet beovi bet hakkosot mitztzad echad – keshera, mishshene tzedadim – terefa. nimtza aleha koret dam –

a: Beyadua shellifne shechita, lo nimtza aleha koret dam – beyadua shelleachar shechita.
Higlid pi hammakka – beyadua sheshshelosha yamim kodem shechita. lo higlid pi hammakka – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya.
Umay shena mikkol nekuve dealma, deaf al gav delekka dam taref mar? hatam lekka midde lemisrach, hacha kevan deikka machat, i ita dekodem shechita hu – misrach hava sarech.

Amar leh rav safra leabbaye: chazi mar hay tzureba merabbanan daata mimmareva, veamar: rav avvira shemeni, veamar: maase uva lifne rabbi machat shennimtzet beovi bet hakkosot mitztzad echad, uterafah. shelach leh la ata legabbeh, azal hu legabbeh. hava kae aiggara, amar: nechot mar venete. la nachet, salek hu legabbeh. amar leh: ema li gufa deovada hechi hava?

Amar leh: maftir kenesiyyot ana, leella merabbi rabba. vahava rav huna tzipporaa verabbi yose madaa yoshvin lefanav, uvat lifne rabbi machat shennimtzet beovi bet hakkosot mitztzad echad, vahafachah rabbi umatza aleha koret dam uterafah, veamar: im en sham makka, koret dam minnayin? amar leh: tera taryeh lehahu gavra! matnitin hi: hemses uvet hakkosot shennikkevu lachutz.
Nafla min haggag, amar rav huna: hinniach behema lemala, uva umetzaah lematta – en choshshin mishshum rissuke evarim.

Hahu gadya dahava leh leravina, dachaza chushela beippuma degar, nefal meiggara leara, atyu lekammeh derav ashe. amar leh: ha deamar rav huna "hinniach behema lemala uva umetzaah lematta en choshshin mishshum rissuke evarim", mishshum deit la midde lemisrach, vehay let leh midde lemisrach? o dilma mishshum deamda nafshah, vehay name amedo nafshe?
Amar leh: mishshum deamda nafshah, vehay name amedo nafshe.

Hahi immarta dahava be rav chaviva, dahavo shadran karay batrayayta. amar rav yemar: hay shigrona naktay. matkef la ravina: vedilma chut hashshidra ippesik? badkuha, ashkechuha keravina. vaafillu hachi, hilcheta kerav yemar, shigrona shechiach, chut hashshidra la shechiach.
Amar rav huna: zecharim hamenaggechin ze et ze – en choshshin mishshum rissuke evarim, af al gav demiddevu vekayymi – tzimra bealma hu denaket lehu; i neful leara – vadday chayyshinan.

Amar rav menashshe: hane dichre deganvi gannave – en choshshin mishshum rissuk evarim, may tama? ki shadu lehu ammotnayyhu shadu lehu, ki hechi delirhatu kammayyhu. ahderinhu – vadday chayyshinan; vehane mille deahderinhu mechamat yira, aval mechamat teshuva – teshuva meallayyta hu deavdi.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: hikkah al roshah vehalcha lah kelappe zenavah, al zenavah vehalcha lah kelappe roshah, keneged kol hashshidra kullah – en choshshin mishshum rissuke evarim, vei shelem chutera appalge degabba – chayyshinan; vei it ba kitre – chayyshinan; vei machyay appaskit – chayyshinan.
Amar rav nachman: bet harechem en bo mishshum rissuke evarim. amar leh rava lerav nachman: tanya dimsayyay lach, tinok ben yom echad
b: Metamme beziva, vei salka datach yesh bo mishshum rissuke evarim, ikri kan "mibbesaro" velo mechamat onso.
Hacha bemay askinan, kegon sheyyatza derech dofen.
Ta shema: egel shennolad beyom tov – shochatin oto beyom tov. hacha name, kegon sheyyatza derech dofen.

Ta shema: veshavin sheim nolad hu umumo immo, shezze min hammuchan. vechi tema hacha name sheyyatza derech dofen – derech dofen mi kadosh? veha amar rabbi yochanan: mode haya rabbi shimon leinyan kadashim sheeno kadosh!
Hacha bemay askinan, shehifris al gabbe karka.
Veamar rav nachman: bet hammitbachayim en bo mishshum rissuke evarim.

Hahu tora dinfal, veishtema kal genichoteh, al rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta shekal mishshufere shufere. amri leh rabbanan: mena lach ha? amar lehu: hachi amar rav: tzippornav noetz ad shemmaggia laaretz.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: amda – enah tzericha meet leet, bedika – vadday baaya, halcha – enah tzericha bedika. rav chiyyay bar ashe amar: achat zo veachat zo tzericha bedika.
