Amar rav yirmeya bar acha amar rav: pashta yadah laamod, af al pi shello amda. akra raglah lehallech, af al pi shello halcha. verav chisda amar: ninara laamod, af al pi shello amda.
Vehilcheta: hecha denafla min haggag bidla yada, veamda velo halcha – tzericha bedika, veenah tzericha meet leet. veim halcha – afillu bedika name la tzericha.

Amar ammemar mishshemeh derav dimi minnehardea: nefula sheamru – tzericha bedika keneged bene meayim. amar leh mar zutera: hachi amrinan mishshemeh derav pappa: tzericha bedika keneged bet hechalal kullo.
Amar leh huna mar bar bereh derav nechemya lerav ashe: simanin may? amar leh: simanin kashin hen etzel nefila.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: of shennechbat al pene hammayim, kevan sheshshat melo komato – dayyo. vela amaran ella mimmatta lemala, aval millemala lematta – mayya hu deashpilu. vei mayya kayymi – let lan ba, vei sheda tzive vekadmeh – ha kadmeh.
Gelima metiach – chayyshinan; dela metiach – la chayyshinan; uf umeuppaf – la chayyshinan; izla umekarvi kitre – chayyshinan; la mekarvi kitre – la chayyshinan.

Kittana daavid betune – chayyshinan; dehay gisa udehay gisa – la chayyshinan; issureyayta – chayyshinan; kittana didyik unefitz – la chayyshinan; deyik vela nefitz – chayyshinan; daavid bizre kevan deikka beh kitre – chayyshinan; dakta – chayyshinan; dakdakta – la chayyshinan.
Navra – chayyshinan; timachta – la chayyshinan; kitma nehila – chayyshinan; la nehila – la chayyshinan.

a: Chol haddak – la chayyshinan; chol haggas – chayyshinan; avak derachim – chayyshinan; tivna vaavid bizga – chayyshinan; la aved bizga – la chayyshinan.

Chitte vechol deminayyhu – chayyshinan; seare vechol deminayyhu – chayyshinan; kol mine kitniyyot – en bahem mishshum rissuke evarim, levar min rubbeya. chimtze – en bo mishshum rissuk evarim, chiftze – yesh bo mishshum rissuk evarim. kelala demilleta: kol midde demashrek – en bo mishshum rissuk evarim, la mashrek – yesh bo mishshum rissuk evarim.
Davok – rav ashe share, ammemar asar. bechad gappa – dechulle alma la peligi dishre, ki peligi bitre gappe. man deasar amar lach: hechi nekum? uman deshare amar lach: efshar denekum aikve degappe.

Veikka deamri: bitre gappe kulle alma la peligi daasir, ki peligi bechad gappa. man deshare amar lach: efshar defarach bechad gappa, uman deasar: kevan divhay la matze parach, behay name la matze parach. vehilcheta: bitre gappe asir, bechad gappa shere.
Nishtabberu rov tzaloteha. tanu rabbanan: ellu hen rov tzelaot – shesh mikkan veshesh mikkan, o achat esre mikkan veachat mikkan.
Amar zeeri: umechetzyayn kelappe shidra. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: uvitzlaot gedolot sheyyesh bahen moach.
Amar ulla, ben zakkay amar: nekeru – berov tzad echad, nishtabberu – berov shene tzedadin. rabbi yochanan amar: ben nekeru ben nishtabberu – berov shene tzedadin.
Amar rav: neekra tzela vechuleya immah – terefa. amri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav: neekra tzela mikkan vetzela mikkan, vechuleya kayyemet, mahu? amar lehu: gistera kaamritu?!
Veha rav name gistera kaamar? ki kaamar rav – tzela belo chuleya.
Veha tzela vechuleya kaamar? tzela vachatzi chuleya.
Mikkelal derav kahana verav assi, tzela belo chuleya amri, vaamar lehu: "gistera kaamritu"? vehaamar ulla: ben zakkay amar: nekeru – berov tzad echad, nishtabberu – berov shene tzedadin.
Amar lach: hatam ze shello keneged ze, hacha ze keneged ze.
Vehaamar rabbi yochanan: berov shene tzedadin, uverov shene tzedadin i efshar dela kayyma (chad) [chada] minnayyhu ze keneged ze!
Hatam – buchena bela asita, hacha – buchena vaasita.
I hachi, hayeynu derav? la shemia lehu derav.
Velivo minneh kidrav? savri: live minneh chada defaresh lan tarte, dei baenan minneh chada, hanicha i amar lan "terefa" – kol shekken tarte, i amar lan "keshera" – akkatti tarte ka mibbaya lan.
I hachi, hasheta name deka bae minneh tarte, hanicha i amar lehu "keshera" – kol shekken chada; vei amar lehu "terefa", akkatti chada mibbaya lehu.
Savri: im ken mirtach ka ratach. chada terefa, tarte mibbaya?
Veha ka amri leh vela ratach, kevan dekaamar lehu "gistera kaamritu" – hayeynu ritcheh.
Amar rabba bar rav shela amar rav matna amar shemuel: neekra tzela meikkarah, vegulegolet shennechbesa berubba, uvasar hachofe et rov hakkares berubbo – terefa.
Neekra tzela meikkarah terefa? ureminhu:
b: Kamma chissaron beshidra? bet shammay omrim: shete chuleyot, uvet hillel omrim: chuleya achat, veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: vechen litrefa.
Hacha – tzela belo chuleya, hatam – chuleya belo tzela.
Bishlama tzela belo chuleya – mashkachat la, ella chuleya belo tzela – hechi mashkachat la? beshilhe kafle.
Matkef la rav oshaya: velitneyay gabbe kulle bet shammay vechumere bet hillel? amar leh rav: ki itteshil – leinyan tumea itteshil, dehavu lehu bet shammay lechumera.
Vegulegolet shennechbesa berubbah. bae rabbi yirmeya: rov govhah, o rov hekkefah? teku.
Uvasar hachofe rov hakkares berubbo. bae rav ashe: berov karua, o berov natul?

Tifshot leh midditnan: kares happenimit shennikkeva, o shennikra rov hachitzona, veamri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi yose berabbi chanina: kol hakkares kullo zo hi kares happenimi, vee zehu kares hachitzona? basar hachofe et rov hakkares.
Midde hu tama, ella lishmuel, hachi amar rabbi yaakov bar nachmani amar shemuel: makom sheen bo melat.
Uderusat hazzeev. amar rav yehuda amar rav: bivhema – min hazzeev ulemala, uveofot – min hannetz ulemala.
Lemaote may? illema lemaote chatul – tenena: "uderusat hazzeev", vechi tema ha ka mashma lan dizev begassa name dares – veha tenan: rabbi yehuda omer: derusat hazzeev baddakka, uderusat ari baggassa!
Vechi tema, rabbi yehuda miflag pelig, vehaamar rabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi ila: lo ba rabbi yehuda ella lefaresh divre chachamim!
Gavra aggavra ka ramet? ibbaet ema: leolam lemaote chatul, mahu detema orcha demilleta katane, ka mashma lan.
Amar rav amram amar rav chisda: derusat chatul unemiyyay bigdayim utelaim, derusat chuleda beofot. metivi: derusat chatul, netz unemiyyay ad shettinnakev lechalal, aval derusa let lehu!
Vetisbera netz la dares? vehatnan: uderusat hannetz! ha la kashya: kan beofot, kan bigdayim utelaim.
Mikkol makom, lerav chisda kashya, hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: beribbi omer: lo amru en derusa ella bemakom sheen matztzilin, aval bimkom sheyyesh matztzilin – yesh derusa.

Uvimkom sheen matztzilin en derusa? veha hahi (tarnegolet) [tarnegolta] dahavay be rav kahana, dirhat chatul batra, veal leidderona, veittechid dashsha beappeh, umachyeh ledashsha besichufeh, veishtechach ala chamsha kurete dema!
Hatztzalat atzmah name kehatztzalat acherim dame, verabbanan – zihara it leh, vela kale zihareh.
Ikka deamri: ha manni? beribbi hi, detanya: beribbi omer: lo amru yesh derusa ella bimkom sheyyesh matztzilin, aval bimkom sheen matztzilin – in derusa.

Uvimkom sheen matztzilin en derusa? veha hahi (tarnegolet) [tarnegolta] dahavay be rav kahana, dirhat chatul batra veal leidderona, veittechid dashsha beappeh, umachyeh ledashsha besichufeh, veishtechach aleh chamishsha kurete dema. hatztzalat atzmah name kehatztzalat acherim damya.
